goal: Restart Analysis UI when git HEAD moves; leave Grok jobs running
non_goals: Do not mutate archive/research or archive/outcomes history
Do not use uvicorn --reload or file watches
Do not kill or re-spawn Grok Analyze/Compare workers
Do not 503 job POSTs during drain; no restart banner; no SHA in CatalogApi.health or fingerprint token
success_criteria: python -m apps.analysis_web polls git HEAD and replaces only the UI child; --no-auto-restart is the one-shot server
SSE hello and /health HTML expose boot git_sha; /api/health and fingerprint token do not
live.js reloads once when hello git_sha changes; catalog hello token still does not reload
Supervisor never taskkill /T or kill_pid the UI; Grok stays detached
